measurements.purpose: Measure the existing antenna loop path so it cannot be mistaken for a direct PCB join.
measurements.conditions: Requested resistance mode, battery/programmer disconnected, antenna wires and Q3 left fitted; user reported readings without separately restating setup.

assessment: B44 M-ANT1 = OL and B45 M-ANT2 = OL; B46 ANT1-ANT2 approximately 5 ohms with antenna requested fitted. No detected DC continuity from the first tuning midpoint to either antenna terminal; a conductive antenna-terminal path is present. This does not establish its exact copper/loop contribution or exclude capacitive RF coupling. No nets merged.
remaining: The opposite C11 end is currently modeled as GND. Verify that assignment against printed GND and ANT1, since the present ground-to-ground tuning-cell model has no supported antenna path.
